brief: Main Street row of two- and three-storey brick commercial buildings of the 1850s-70s: a flat-roofed two-storey store with a cast-iron front and upper porch, and a taller Italianate block with arched hooded windows and a bracketed cornice. Record: 5 photos plus 3 drawing sheets.

facade.notes: 202-230 Main Street, Warsaw IL (1860s): a row of commercial fronts of mixed materials -- a frame false front with a balcony over the shop, a gabled frame store, a two-storey stuccoed brick row with traditional shopfronts -- along a quiet Mississippi River town street (HABS 1930s)

why.note: frame false fronts beside brick: a river town outside any fire limits
